cues.text:
You made us Yours and called us near
Your faithful love has brought us here

With grateful hearts, we sing Your praise
Your goodness holds us all our days

Lift up your voice
Make a joyful noise

We are Yours, we are Yours
In Your love we rejoice

Jesus lives, our hope is true
We will live forever with You

Hearts awake and voices raised
Let our lives become Your praise

When sorrow comes, You hold us fast
Your promised life will always last

Though tears may fall, our hope remains
The risen Jesus breaks death's chains

Lift up your voice
Make a joyful noise

We are Yours, we are Yours
In Your love we rejoice

Jesus lives, our hope is true
We will live forever with You

Hearts awake and voices raised
Let our lives become Your praise

One day the tears will fall no more
And death will close its final door

You'll make Your home with us at last
The grief and pain will all be past
Until that day, our hearts will sing
Our living hope, our risen King

Lift up your voice
Make a joyful noise

We are Yours, we are Yours
In Your love we rejoice

Jesus lives, our hope is true
We will live forever with You

Hearts awake and voices raised
Let our lives become Your praise

We are Yours, we are Yours
In Your love we rejoice
